investigation_notes.Description: An inbound Network Security Group rule was added to nsg-prod-core in the production connectivity resource group that allows TCP/3389 from any source, increasing external exposure and enabling RDP from the internet. The activity originated from a Tallinn IP during local business hours and the IP has a clean reputation, but the requesting user (Senior Legal Operations Manager) does not have a job function that typically requires infrastructure changes and there are no correlated deployment events or similar alerts. Given the broad access introduced in a production environment, the identity-role mismatch, and lack of corroborating activity, this alert is classified as High Priority for further investigation.
